description: This file defines a Java interface 'UserService' that declares methods for user management functionalities such as creating users, fetching user roles, reading all users, and deleting a user.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A Java interface declaring user-related operations for the billing software system.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user based on the provided UserRequest object.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves the role of a user given their email address.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Returns a list of all users as UserResponse objects.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user identified by the given ID.
